model_instrument.model_version: not exposed beyond product model name

epistemic_status: all blind records are unsourced model-memory research leads, not Fact, Judgment, Reality, Outcome or Evidence
hbm_scope: HBM is a DRAM product branch; HBM metrics are never proxies for total DRAM.
blind_rules: No semiconductor web/search/source material was consumed during Stage A.
Preserve uncertain fragments instead of fabricating precision.
Keep DRAM/NAND price, inventory, bit growth, technology and qualification metrics distinct.
Canonical blind lead shards are immutable after this seal commit.
Memory Leads remain below Evidence authority.

seal.saturation_basis: Final three orthogonal atlas-only gap passes each produced zero high-importance novel leads; both core product lines and required long-tail families were reviewed with no major unreviewed block.
seal.reopen_rule: new model vintage, explicit scope expansion, or later verified evidence exposing a major blind-category omission

next_stage_boundary: Search begins only in a new post-seal run after this commit is live; search may refine or verify leads but may never rewrite Stage-A blind shards.
